note: A deck as a media team would build it: statements the preacher makes, scripture text (KJV), headings. 'at' is when the slide should come up (the preacher starts on it); null = on the deck but never reached.

slides.text: Enough Is Enough
God does not reward position, He rewards contribution. God does not reward status, He rewards service.
God does not owe you anything. But you owe Him obedience.
Romans 8:28 And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
There is no accusation against God that will change your position. Reposition yourself in obedience.
You are long overdue for a change of position
Nothing commits God to anybody like the individual's obedience
A sworn blessing is an irreversible blessing
No prayer can be a substitute for obedience
What God does is to take over the battles of the obedient
Understanding the Unlimited Power of Faith
Faith is an asset of inestimable value. It is worth anything one can ever desire in life.
Mark 9:23 Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
Don't mistake being in a faith-based church for having faith
Your faith won't build itself
Value is a function of cost
Faith is that force that invades the invisible world and delivers its mission with precision
John 1:5 And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
Every one of our problems is a faith question
Until your faith dies, no devil can kill you
Faith is a display of confidence in God until the desired result is obtained
Hebrews 10:35 Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.

Romans 4:20-21 He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God; and being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
Faith is the master key to a world of unlimited possibilities
Faith is a spiritual battery. It must be kept charged.
Romans 10:17 So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
The challenges of life have no timetable. Live ready.
Faith is a weapon, not an ideology
Ephesians 6:16 Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
Bible faith unleashes its power through the tongue

Mark 11:23 Whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
A closed mouth equals a closed destiny
Isaiah 53:7 He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth
God cannot confirm what you will not declare
Faith is not fake. Faith is real.
John 18:6 As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
You can never win the war with a closed mouth
Habakkuk 3:2 O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
Habakkuk 3:6 The everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.
Every affliction of long continuance is a curse
Deuteronomy 28:59 Then the LORD will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
Numbers 23:23 Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel
Galatians 3:13 Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree
Numbers 23:8 How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the LORD hath not defied?
Numbers 23:20 Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
1 Peter 5:10 After that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
2 Corinthians 4:17 For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory
Psalm 30:5 For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
It is faith that turns our situations into testimonies
1 John 5:4 For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
Operation Run is my opportunity to emerge a prize winner in the race of life
Everyone truly serving God cannot be held hostage by the devil
Exodus 4:22-23 Israel is my son, even my firstborn: Let my son go, that he may serve me
